headline: Oil Prices Decline Following US Midterm Election Results
summary: Brent and West Texas Intermediate crude oil prices fell significantly following the U.S. midterm election results. Markets are reacting to potential shifts in energy policy under a Democratic sweep.
why: Crude oil prices are a primary global commodity benchmark, and energy sector stocks are highly sensitive to U.S. regulatory and legislative changes regarding fossil fuel production and environmental policy.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Market sentiment regarding U.S. energy policy shifts has led to a sell-off in oil futures.
